derived.claim: Closes F13. The canon fixes dispatch only as the Agent tool and a roster of 'the persona agents in agents/' by persona names (:114, :149). No line says dispatch is by the shipped agent name resolved by the host, and nothing else states it. So the by-name assumption holds by convention of naming only; it is not a stated contract. Fix: one sentence in the dispatch rules saying personas are dispatched by agent name, which makes the host-precedence coupling explicit and FR-006-compatible.

The roster is defined as the persona agents in agents/.

derived.claim: Derived from F32 and F44: the recipe and installer collide in a per-project install, where the shipped file and the copy occupy the same path. There the copy is not a project-level override of a global plugin file; it is an edit of the installed file, and the next ./install.sh run skips it ('skip, not installed by this script') or, with --force, overwrites it. The recipe must branch on install mode: for a CLAUDE_HOME=$PWD/.claude install, edit in place and never use --force. Spec.md:57 ('the installer writes only under the Claude home') is the unstated premise, and in this mode it does not protect the copy.

evidence.note: Per-project install sets CLAUDE_HOME to the project's .claude.
Unrecorded existing file is skipped; --force replaces it.

derived.pull_quote: In a per-project install there is no override at all, only an edit of the installed file.
